title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Organize Liquidation of a Private School Terminated Due to Insolvency and Inability to Continue Operation

articles.content_en:
December 29, 2010
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Issues Concerning How to Organize Liquidation of Non-Government-Sponsored Schools Terminated for Unable to Continue Operation Due to Insolvency
Fa Shi [2010] No. 20
(Adopted at the 1506th Session of the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court on December 16, 2010; Promulgated by the Announcement of the Supreme People's Court on December 29, 2010; and shall come into force as of December 31, 2010)
Higher People's Court of Guizhou Province:
Your Request for Instructions on How the People's Court Shall Accept "Organizing Liquidation" after Zunyi County Zhongshan Middle School Was Terminated ( [2010] Qian Gao Yan Qing Zi No. 1) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
If a non-government-sponsored school established with approval in accordance with Article 9 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Promotion of Privately-Run Schools is terminated for being unable to continue operation due to insolvency, and a party files an application with the People's Court for liquidation in accordance with the second paragraph of Article 58 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Promotion of Privately-Run Schools, the People's Court shall accept the case according to law. The People's Court ordering the bankruptcy liquidation of a non-government-sponsored school shall apply mutatis mutandis the procedures prescribed in the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China and make repayment in the order provided in Article 59 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Promotion of Privately-Run Schools.
